title: Weekly planning
description: App Store screenshot meeting: Kestrel Labs prepares the version two beta. Turns are scheduled back to back from measured Kokoro durations. The first 14 s are silent so the recording, started once the call is live, catches every line.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Morning everyone. Two things today: confirm the date for the version two beta, and decide how much of offline mode makes the cut.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: On the date, I'm comfortable with Monday the third of November. The booking engine is done, and the last piece is sync.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: And offline mode? That's the thing Riverside Clinic keeps asking about.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Reading the schedule offline works today. Editing offline is the hard part, because two people can change the same appointment and we have to resolve the conflict when they reconnect.

turns.speaker: hannah
turns.text: From the design side, I'd rather ship read only offline and do it well. A clear banner that says you're offline, and the last time we synced.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: I agree. Sync conflicts are where the bugs will be. If editing offline goes into the beta, I need at least two extra weeks of testing.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Then let's decide. The beta ships on the third of November with read only offline mode. Offline editing moves to the release after.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Works for me. I'll write up the conflict rules so we can start on editing straight after.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Great. Hannah, can you mock up the offline banner by Friday?

turns.speaker: hannah
turns.text: Yes, I'll share it in the design channel on Thursday.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: And I'll draft the beta test plan, with offline as its own section.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Perfect. Leo will tell Riverside Clinic on Wednesday's call. Thanks everyone.
